citations.quote: The phase 2a MyPathway study assigned patients with HER2, EGFR, BRAF or SHH alterations to treatment with pertuzumab plus trastuzumab, erlotinib, vemurafenib, or vismodegib, respectively. Of 26 patients with BRAF V600E mutations, objective responses were seen in 12 patients (46%; 95% CI, 27% to 67%). Only one of 23 patients (4%; 95% CI, 0% to 22%) with other non-V600 BRAF mutations had a PR (pancreas cancer with a CUX1-BRAF fusion). Nonresponding BRAF mutations included: K601E (n = 6), G464V (n = 2), G469A (n = 2), G496A (n = 2), N581S (n = 2), and one each for G466V, G596R, G606E, L597Q,
